༄༅/ /'jigs byed dmar po'i sgrub thabs las sbyor dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /ya mān+ta kā ya na mo na maḥdapal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtogs pa'i rgyu

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'jigs byed dmar po'i sgrub thabs las sbyor dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ya mān+ta kā ya na mo na maḥ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtogs pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las sbyor ba'i le'u zhes bya ba'i le'u gnyis par/ de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid chos thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro ba dang ldog pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas gsang sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i phrin las 'di nyid bka' bstsal te/ nam mkha'i dbyings su dbus gnas par// hūm̐ las yongs su rdzogs pa yi// rdo rje 'jigs byed bsam par bya// dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// shes rab ma dang mnyam du sbyor// dbyug pa thod khrag phyag na 'dzin// ma he pad+ma nyi ma la// g.yon pa brkyang ba'i tshul du bsgom// oṃ ya mān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsang sngags rgyal po 'di bzlas na// 'dod pa'i dngos grub thams cad 'byung*// zhes gsal por gsungs pa nyams su blang ba'i rim pa ni/ dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba rnams su/ 'di nyid kyi bris sku'i mdun du sman raka gtor ma mchod pa bsham/ dbang thob dam la gnas pa'i sgrub pa pos| gzhi bgegs la gtor ma byin la bka' bsgo/ skyabs sems tshangs gnas yid dang 'dre ba sngon du song nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥbadz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ de ltar rnal 'byor rnam gsum gyi gzung ba dang 'dzin pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang nyid kyis dag pa'i stong pa 'od gsal chen po'i ngang las/ ma he nag po rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa rab tu khros pa'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rang rig hūm̐ dmar po 'bar zhing 'phro ba las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas 'dus/ yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog dmar po 'jig dus kyi bskal pa'i me'i lhun po mched pa lta bu 'bar zhing g.yo la 'khrugs pa ma he'i zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/

ljags 'gyur pheṃ gyi sgra 'byin pa/ spyan gsum me ltar 'bar zhing sdang mig phyogs bcur g.yo ba/ rwa sngon po gdengs shing skra dmar ser brdzes pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ mi rus kyi phyag rgya lnga dang thal bas byugs pa/ mi lpags kyis stod g.yogs pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas dbyug pa 'phyar zhing g.yon dung chen dgra bgegs kyi snying khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa'i pang du yum rdo rje ro langs ma sngo sangs g.yas gri khug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan gsum 'khrugs pa/ skra grol zhing thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal can phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ zhabs gnyis yab kyi sked la 'khril ba/ yab yum gnyis ka ye shes kyi me 'od 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i 'od kyis rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ snying gar nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐ gi mthar/ sngags kyis bskor ba spro zhing bsdu ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur par bsam/ oṃ ya mān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas 'bru 'bum bzla'o// thun mtshams su mchod pa dang*/ sman raka gtor mas mchod/ bstod pa gang rung gi bstod pa sogs bya'o// de ltar bsnyen nas las la sbyor ba byed na/ rgyud las/ khyad par du'ang bsad pa la// dmar po ma he'i zhal can ni// rtse gsum lcags kyu 'dzin pa ste// ma he'i sha steng bsams byas na// khrag 'dren pa yi mchog tu gsungs// res 'ga' sku las khro bo ni// lcags kyu 'dzin pa grangs med 'phros// zhes bsad pa mthar thug dang*/ yang de nyid las/ zla ba spyang kis zin dus su// byi la'i sder mo rwa snying dang*// bya yi khrag dang mi rus bsres// gang la phog pa smyo bar 'gyur// zhes smyo 'bog brgyal myos bzhi rnams kyi las sbyor gsungs pa ni lag len rdo rje slob dpon zhal las shes shing*/

yang de nyid las/ zhi la zhi ba'i yid kyis te// rgyal po lta bu rgyas pa la// sdang bral chags pas dbang la'o// drag po'i las la khro zhing rtsub// rab tu gtum pa'i yid kyis ni// gsod pa'i sems dang ldan par bya// zhes phrin las rnam bzhi ting nge 'dzin kho nas sgrub tshul yang gsungs te zhal shes ltar byos shig /rdo rje 'chang gi gsang ba'i gnad/ /rgyud du sbas pa'i ke sa ra// bdag blo'i nyi 'od kyis phye yi// blo ldan bung ba'i nyer spyad 'os// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtogs pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las sbyor ba'i le'u zhes le'u gnyis par gsungs pa'i 'jigs byed dmar po lhan skyes shin tu drag po'i bdag nyid mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs las sbyor dang bcas pa sbas don gsal por byas pa 'di'ang*/ 'bri gung pa rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pas me glang zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes lnga la pho brang bkra shis tshugs su sbyar ba dag go// /sarba maṅga laṃ//
